text:
Riley: Red-eye tonight. Looking for 200-page books or <15min reads + super chill shows to nap to. No heavy twists pls.
Chen: 'The Little Prince' reread is perfect and tiny. For shows, 'Pushing Daisies' S1 is whimsical and shortish eps.
Izzy: Try Kazuo Ishiguro's 'Nocturnes' (short stories) 90ish pages. For nap-watch: 'Bob's Burgers' light episodes.
Marta: Micro-read: some R.K. Narayan short stories. Also 'Parks and Rec' eps are warm and familiar.
Chen: K-Helper: added 'sleepy-playlist' sticker :zzz:.
Riley: Nice. Any audiobook or podcast recs that aren't too engaging? want something to drift in/out of.
Izzy: Ambient music playlists, or the 'Calm' app short stories. Pod: 'Sleep With Me' is meant to be boring in a good way.
Marta: If you want fiction but chill: 'Ethan Frome' is short and slow-moving.
Riley: Perfect, downloading. Thanks team :airplane: :headphones:
